meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把网页应用发布到 Vercel，管理域名和环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把网站部署到 Vercel 并管理其设置
copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: 操作 Vercel 部署网站：先检查本地构建、部署状态和线上地址是否可访问，确认无误后才给出链接；还能管理项目、域名和环境变量。
howto.when: 当你说要部署、发布或上线某个网站，或要求管理 Vercel 的项目、域名、环境变量等时。

say.text: 帮我把当前项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境
say.note: 会先本地构建，再部署并检查链接是否可用

say.text: 列出我在 Vercel 上的所有项目
say.note: 会调用命令列出项目清单

say.text: 给生产环境添加一个变量，名字叫 API_KEY
say.note: 会用管道方式添加，避免交互提示

howto.what_en: Operates Vercel to deploy websites: runs local build, checks deployment status and live URL before sharing it; also manages projects, domains, and environment variables.
howto.when_en: When you ask to deploy, ship, or publish a web app, or to manage Vercel projects, domains, or environment variables.

say_en.text: Deploy the current project to Vercel production.
say_en.note: Builds locally, then deploys and verifies the URL.

say_en.text: List all my projects on Vercel.
Add an environment variable named API_KEY for production.
say_en.note: Uses echo piping to avoid prompts.
